reason: I'm only at that subway exit two mornings a week, and I don't try anywhere new until it has a real Google rating. A brand-new café inside a bar, with no reviews yet, isn't where I'm spending $8 on my way to work.
objection: It looks like a closed bar, not a café. I'd honestly walk past it, and with zero reviews I have no idea whether the drinks are good or just made for Instagram.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it at 4.5 stars or higher on Google with a decent number of reviews that say the matcha is actually good, plus a clear café sign out front so I know it's open in the morning.
